description: This file defines the Operation class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing an abstraction of an API operation with methods for retrieving HTTP attributes, input/output shapes, errors, and context parameters.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents an API operation with methods to access its HTTP details, input/output shapes, errors, and context parameters, extending AbstractModel.

methods.name: getHttp
methods.description: Returns an array of HTTP attributes of the operation, such as method and request URI.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the shape representing the input of the operation, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the shape representing the output of the operation, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of error shapes related to the operation.

methods.name: getStaticContextParams
methods.description: Returns static context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Returns dynamic context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getOperationContextParams
methods.description: Returns the definition of dynamic values used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: setContextParams
methods.description: Initializes the context parameters based on input shape members.
